758:t_1:753.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Well... If you dive with $$チェインバー#pilot$$, the $$クジライカ$$ will get wary too.」

758:t_1:754.en:
$$レド$$
「I've learned how to keep them from getting wary. If I read their signs of anger, I can avoid provoking them.」

758:t_1:755.en:
$$レド$$
「As our research progresses, we may eventually be able to communicate with them.」

758:t_1:757.en:
$$レド$$
「It's thanks to you and everyone in this fleet teaching me what matters, $$エイミー$$.」

758:t_1:758.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Coexistence and mutual prosperity are a fundamental truth of the universe.」

758:t_1:759.en:
$$レド$$
「I'd like to teach the $$人類銀河同盟$$ that truth someday too.」

758:t_1:760.en:
$$ベローズ$$
「Are you going back to space?」

758:t_1:761.en:
$$レド$$
「No. The $$ガルガンティア船団$$ is the place I come home to.」

758:t_1:763.en:
$$レド$$
「If I ever go to the Alliance, $$エイミー$$... I'd like to take you with me.」

758:t_1:764.en:
$$エイミー$$
「You want to take me?」

758:t_1:765.en:
$$レド$$
「Yes... I want you to see where I was born, $$エイミー$$.」

758:t_1:766.en:
$$エイミー$$
「All right, $$レド$$. When the time comes, let's go together.」

758:t_1:767.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit will serve as your guide on that occasion.」

758:t_1:769.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Understood. This unit will also consider navigation through the parallel worlds in the future.」

758:t_1:770.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit will do so in order to reunite with them.」

758:t_1:771.en:
$$レド$$
「I'll still be relying on you for a while, $$チェインバー#pilot$$.」

758:t_1:772.en:
$$レド$$
(That's right. I'll live alongside $$エイミー$$ and $$チェインバー#pilot$$... alongside my friends.)

758:t_1:773.en:
$$レド$$
(This green planet... and this new world are where I and the people I care about will live.)

758:t_1:780.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's a little out of season, but...」

758:t_1:781.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'll now hand out our first bonuses!」

758:t_1:782.en:
$$木下$$
「O-our company is finally paying bonuses!」

758:t_1:784.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't say that, $$郁絵$$! This is the result of all our employees' hard work up to today!」

758:t_1:786.en:
$$厚井$$
「What's wrong, Executive Director? Aren't you happy about the bonus?」

758:t_1:787.en:
$$柿小路$$
「Of course I'm happy... But if this puts the business in trouble, our bonuses may turn into severance pay...」

758:t_1:788.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It'll be fine. In this hyperdimensional world, parallel worlds stretch out beyond the gates.」

758:t_1:789.en:
$$郁絵$$
「So there are infinite places where we can find work.」

758:t_1:790.en:
$$木下$$
「I'll do my best! I'll become a $$ゲートトラベラー$$ and drum up business!」

758:t_1:791.en:
$$厚井$$
「Oh... That bonus has the Section Chief full of enthusiasm.」

758:t_1:792.en:
$$柿小路$$
「With my subordinate so enthusiastic, this is no time for me, his superior, to be worrying.」

758:t_1:793.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Exactly, Executive Director. Besides, tomorrow I'll...」

758:t_1:794.en:
$$加代$$
「$$ワッ太$$... Miss $$美重子$$ and Mr. $$大門$$ are here.」

758:t_1:795.en:
$$大門$$
「Hey, $$ワッ太$$! I'm glad to see you're doing well.」

758:t_1:796.en:
$$美重子$$
「I came to make sure you haven't forgotten about tomorrow.」

758:t_1:797.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't worry! It's the graduation ceremony I've been waiting for, after all.」

758:t_1:798.en:
$$厚井$$
「I see... Tomorrow is your elementary school graduation.」

758:t_1:799.en:
$$木下$$
「So you'll no longer be our elementary school President.」

758:t_1:800.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Instead, I'll be a little more grown-up, so I'll work harder than ever!」

758:t_1:801.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Then we won't call you our Young President anymore.」

758:t_1:802.en:
$$厚井$$
「That's right. You're a fine President in every respect now.」

758:t_1:803.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I've still got a long way to go.」

758:t_1:804.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'll only be able to call myself President with pride when the Executive Director stops worrying about bankruptcy and we can pay bonuses every summer and winter.」

758:t_1:805.en:
$$木下$$
「That's our President! Let's celebrate this new chapter in his life in style!」

758:t_1:806.en:
$$郁絵$$
「Then let's all give the President a cheer!」

758:t_1:807.en:
$$厚井$$
「This'll be the last time we use this cheer, so let's give it everything we've got.」

758:t_1:808.en:
$$木下$$
「Come now... Madam, the teachers, and Mr. $$梅本$$, please join in too!」

758:t_1:810.en:
$$梅本$$
($$竹尾$$... Your son is growing up strong, together with the $$トライダー$$ you and I created.)

758:t_1:811.en:
$$柿小路$$
「All right, everyone... Here we go!」

758:t_1:815.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(I'll... work hard with everyone and $$トライダー$$ to make $$竹尾ゼネラルカンパニー$$ the number-one company in the hyperdimensional world!)

758:t_1:816.en:
$$ワッ太$$
(And I'll go see $$勝平$$ and everyone else! I'll introduce us as the hyperdimensional world's jack-of-all-trades!)

758:t_1:820.en:
$$正太郎$$
「...So you're coming to Earth next month?」

758:t_1:821.en:
$$グーラ$$
「It's a good opportunity. I thought I'd try being one of these middle school students too.」

758:t_1:822.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Dr. $$敷島$$ says he'll be your guardian. I'm looking forward to seeing you again, $$グーラ$$.」

758:t_1:823.en:
$$グーラ$$
「So am I. See you, then...」

758:t_1:824.en:
$$正太郎$$
「The fighting is over now... You can live alongside us too, $$グーラ$$.」

758:t_1:825.en:
$$マッキー$$
「But you're going to stay an $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ special investigator, aren't you, $$正太郎$$?」

758:t_1:826.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Even if there's no more fighting on a cosmic scale, there'll still be criminals.」

758:t_1:827.en:
$$正太郎$$
「$$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$ will keep fighting those bad guys as before.」

758:t_1:829.en:
$$敷島$$
「Don't be selfish, $$牧子$$. $$正太郎$$ has decided for himself how he wants to live.」

758:t_1:833.en:
$$大塚$$
「We've had a report of a group hiding on a deserted island who appear to be remnants of the $$ロボットマフィア$$. I'd like you to head out there.」

758:t_1:834.en:
$$マッキー$$
「Wait, Chief! $$正太郎$$'s elementary school graduation is tomorrow!」

758:t_1:835.en:
$$大塚$$
「I-I see... Then you can't go.」

758:t_1:838.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It's all right, $$マッキー$$. I'll be back soon.」
